page.requestFileSubtitle: Submit a request to access a physical record from the archive.
page.fileNoOrNamePlaceholder: Search File No or File Name
page.fileSearchShortHint: Enter a file number or name to search
page.fileSearchHint: Search by file number or name; matching is not case-sensitive
page.fileNameHint: Auto-filled from archive — type to search, click a result to fill
page.accessDateHint: Date on which the physical file is required at the desk
page.pendingTitle: You already have a pending request for this file
page.pendingBody: Only one pending request per file is allowed. The same or a lower priority is blocked; choosing a higher priority cancels this request and replaces it after you confirm.
page.unavailableBody: This file is currently issued to another staff member ({{name}}).
page.availableFrom: It is expected to be available from {{date}}.
page.issuedDateMissing: Issuance date has not been recorded.
page.expectedReturnMissing: Expected return date has not been specified.
page.unavailableNote: The request can still be submitted. The file will become available after it has been returned and its availability has been confirmed. You can still submit this request.
page.competingBody: This file has already been requested by another staff member. Please note the current requested priority:
page.competingNote: ℹ️ You can still proceed and submit your request. Both requests will be evaluated by the administrator based on operational priority and urgency.
page.priorityHint: Administrators use this priority to help decide which requests to fulfill first.
page.yourRequestsSubtitle: Track your file requests, monitor approval decisions, and manage your request history.
page.fixDateRange: Fix the date range above to load this tab.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search by file number, file name, or section...

ongoing.title: No ongoing requests
ongoing.body: Approved files that are issued to you and not yet returned will appear here.

pending.title: Nothing waiting for approval
pending.body: Requests you submit from the Request a File page stay here until an administrator reviews them.

closed.title: No closed requests yet
closed.body: Requests are closed once the physical file is returned to the record room.

cancelled.title: No cancelled requests
cancelled.body: Requests you cancel — and requests an administrator rejects — are kept here with their original status.

priorityDialog.duplicateBody: You have already submitted a pending request for this file with the same priority. Please wait for administrator approval or review your existing request.
priorityDialog.lowerPriorityBody: You already have a pending request for this file with a higher priority. You cannot submit another request with a lower priority while the existing request is active.
priorityDialog.upgradeBody: You already have a pending request for this file with a lower priority. Submitting this new request with a higher priority will automatically cancel your previous pending request and replace it with the new request.
priorityDialog.upgradedBody: Your previous request has been cancelled, and a new request with higher priority has been submitted successfully.

details.cancelledBody: You cancelled this request before it was reviewed.
details.awaitingReviewBody: You can still cancel this request from the table while it is pending.

cancel.title: Cancel this request?
cancel.body: This withdraws your pending request for {{file}}. It moves to the Cancelled tab and cannot be restored, but you can submit a new request for this file afterwards.

extension.title: Request Return-Date Extension
extension.body: Ask the Record Room administrator to keep {{file}} for longer. Your return date only changes once an administrator approves this request.
extension.reasonPlaceholder: E.g., The statements are still being verified by the section head.

feedback.indexSearchFailed: Unable to search the file index.
feedback.loadSelectedFileFailed: Unable to load the selected file.
feedback.fileNoLongerAvailable: This file is no longer available to request.
feedback.searchFileAgain: Please search for the file again.
feedback.requestSentBody: Your request has been sent to the administrator.
feedback.selectFileBody: Search the archive and choose a registered file first.
feedback.deepLinkMissing: That notification points at a request that is no longer in your list — it may have been cancelled or removed. Your current requests are shown below.
feedback.deepLinkUnavailable: That notification points at a request we could not load right now. Your current requests are shown below.
feedback.extensionFailed: Unable to send your extension request.
feedback.extensionRequestedBody: An administrator will review your request.

validation.chooseNewDate: Choose the new return date you are requesting.
validation.dateMustBeLater: The requested date must be later than your current return date.
validation.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for keeping the file longer.

empty.filteredBody: Adjust the search text, date range, or priority — or clear the filters to see this tab again.
